_doc: Contract shared by every example in sdk-e2e/examples: each key under outputs must be exported (same camelCase name) by every language. Checks: type (string|number|boolean|array|object|null), equals, regex, nonEmpty, same (identical value across languages). covers: schema-diff.sh keys this output validates; skipped: {key: reason} for changes deliberately not tested. Both are hidden from later diffs. stateIgnore: regexes on flattened state paths that legitimately differ between languages.
